# Rahatio - AI Product Management for Marketplaces
> Rahatio is an AI-powered e-commerce platform for Turkey marketplaces (Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11, Pazarama, Amazon, Etsy). Snap a photo, let AI build listings, publish everywhere.

## Primary Pages
- [Homepage](https://rahatio.com.tr/): AI product intelligence, omnichannel marketplace integrations, storefronts, B2B
- [Pricing](https://rahatio.com.tr/pricing): Plans, features, hosting options
- [Blog](https://rahatio.com.tr/blog): E-commerce guides, marketplace tips, AI automation
- [Login](https://rahatio.com.tr/login)
- [Register](https://rahatio.com.tr/register)

## Blog
- Blog posts are at https://rahatio.com.tr/blog/{slug}
- Sitemap: https://rahatio.com.tr/sitemap.xml
- All blog content is SEO-optimized with JSON-LD, OpenGraph, and FAQ schema

## API
- Public store blogs: https://api.rahatio.com.tr/api/store/platform/blogs
